description: Implementation of CurrencyReadPlatformService for retrieving currency data from the database, including methods to retrieve allowed currencies, all platform currencies, and a specific currency by code.

classes.name: CurrencyReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class responsible for reading currency data from the database.

classes.name: CurrencyRowMapper
classes.description: Nested static class implementing RowMapper to map ResultSet rows to CurrencyData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches list of allowed currencies from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllPlatformCurrencies

methods.name: retrieveCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves currency data for a specific currency code.
